title: cardamine pratensis subsp. nuriae
intro: Cardamine pratensis subsp. nuriae, commonly known as Spring Cress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Spring Cress include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Spring Cress include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
